name: 14.ai
long_description:
We are building GloGlo, an AI companion for people with diabetes. GloGlo connects to CGMs and health data to explain what is driving highs, lows, and time in range, then turns those patterns into personalized insights, reminders, and daily guidance.

We are starting with people with Type 1 diabetes, a community we know firsthand through our cofounder Michael, who has lived with T1D for 17 years. Alongside the app, we make fast-acting glucose gummies for treating lows, giving us a trusted consumer entry point into the diabetes market.

Our long-term goal is to become the everyday operating system for diabetes: understanding each person’s glucose, insulin, food, exercise, sleep, and habits so they can make better decisions and spend more time in range.
one_liner: AI companion helping people with diabetes stay in range
